scoring_justification: The hidden checker recomputes per-row agreement against the paper's reported adsorption energies, heights, charge transfers, midgap booleans, and dissociation barriers using inline gold values and directional tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold adsorption energies, heights, charge transfers, midgap flags, and O2 dissociation barriers from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 and related paragraphs; values are replicated exactly as reported.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's published numeric results; no transformation applied.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual reported quantities that the reproduction task targets; they serve as the authoritative hidden reference.

schema.description: Each row: molecule (H2O or O2), substrate (perfect, MV, DV), adsorption_energy_eV (float, more negative is better).

outputs.description: Adsorption energies; lower (more negative) values indicate stronger binding.

schema.description: Each row: molecule (H2O or O2), substrate (perfect, MV, DV), height_A (float, distance in Å).

outputs.description: Adsorption heights; compared to hidden reference within a small tolerance.

schema.description: Each row: molecule (H2O or O2), substrate (perfect, MV, DV), delta_q_e (float, positive means electron transfer from molecule to phosphorene).

outputs.description: Net electron transfer; value must match reference within a tolerance.
Boolean flags for midgap state presence; exact match required for each system.

schema.description: Each row: substrate (perfect or MV), barrier_eV (float, lower barrier is better/easier dissociation).

outputs.description: O₂ dissociation energy barriers; a lower value than the reference is also acceptable.

output_contract.notes: All scored artifacts are derived from DFT computations. The checker compares submitted values to hidden gold within predefined tolerances; directional metrics allow better-than-paper results to earn full credit.
